name: shomra
description: Gate and fix AI artifacts (MCP servers, Skills, rules, hooks) and flag known-vulnerable AI models right in your editor. Works in VS Code and Cursor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Shomra runs the local `shomra` CLI, so it only activates in trusted workspaces.

commands.title: Check AI Models in This File

shomra.executable.markdownDescription: The `shomra` CLI command, or an absolute path. For a repo checkout point it at the script, e.g. `node /path/to/Shomra.Agent/shomra.mjs` — a value ending in `.mjs`/`.js` is run with Node automatically.

shomra.checkOnSave.description: Run Shomra when you save an AI-artifact file (MCP config, Skill, rules, hook, …).

shomra.checkOnOpen.description: Run Shomra when you open OR switch to an AI-artifact file (not only on save).

shomra.checkModels.description: Scan source files (Python, notebooks, JS/TS) for AI models you load and flag any that are known-vulnerable in the Shomra Model Index — squiggled on the model-load line, on save and open.

shomra.checkWorkspaceOnStartup.description: Scan the whole workspace once when the window opens. Off by default so large repos don't pay it on every launch.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle:cli && npm run compile
